question: What sovereign status does the goddess hold over sky-clad groups?
premises: The goddess is adored by the group of sky-clad goddesses.
The goddess is the sovereign of the group of the sky-clad.
Adoration and sovereignty establish her supreme position.
inference: The goddess is both adored by and sovereign over the sky-clad groups.
plain_english: She is adored by the group of sky-clad goddesses and is the sovereign of the sky-clad group.
